stage.name: Away Streak
stage.description:
A good team must be able to perform on the road.
<Winter Field> Friction is reduced, and enemies have increased Movement Speed.
<Mercy Rule> First team to get a 5-goal lead wins.

flying_boots_mercenary.name: 'Flying Boots' Mercenary
flying_boots_mercenary.flavourText: Propelled by compressed air cans beneath their feet, 'Flying Boots' mercenaries raid and plunder on the winds.
abilities: Capable of evading physical attacks. Loses Physical Dodge against a Stabilizer Chain.

sarkaz_sentinel.name: Sarkaz Sentinel
sarkaz_sentinel.flavourText: A Sarkaz mercenary. They are responsible for scouting, patrolling, and issuing early warnings to the entire squad. Once attacked, the Herald will immediately issue a warning that Inspires the entire army, shifting allied Sarkaz on Standby into Combat-Ready mode.
abilities: When injured, issues an alarm to immediately enhance the ATK and DEF of all enemy units, and makes enemies in Standby immediately enter Combat-Ready mode

bounty_hunter_knight.name: Bounty Hunter 'Knight'
bounty_hunter_knight.flavourText: Bounty hunters skilled in witchcraft, equipped with self-made gear inspired by Kazimierzian knights. They take pleasure in tormenting their targets during missions.
abilities: Accelerates when moving. First attack after being blocked deals extra Arts damage based on movement speed.

deathveil_assassin.name: Deathveil Assassin
deathveil_assassin.flavourText: Sarkaz assassins who have abandoned their names and cut off their horns. Behind their pall is a burning fanaticism and a destined fate.
abilities: Invisible; the next attack made after breaking Invisibility will deal increased damage.
Has Arts and Physical dodge.
Temporarily loses Invisibility, Physical dodge, and Arts dodge against a Stabilizer Chain.
Can pass through a blocking unit once when HP drops to below 50%.

sarkaz_lancer.name: Sarkaz Lancer
sarkaz_lancer.flavourText: A Sarkaz mercenary. After special training, they are capable of rushing forward with a long spear, building up speed. The faster they charge, the harder they strike anyone who might stand in their way.
abilities: Gradually accelerates when moving, and deals additional damage on the first attack after being blocked based upon Movement Speed.

longshot_field_shooter.name: 'Longshot' Field Shooter
longshot_field_shooter.flavourText: This musbeast was recruited as shooter under the reasoning that if it can leap high, it can kick a ball very, very far away. I mean really far away.
abilities: Prioritizes attacking the football towards your goal.

sarkaz_grudgebearer.name: Sarkaz Grudgebearer
sarkaz_grudgebearer.flavourText: A Sarkaz mercenary. Their Originium-wracked bodies have become convenient tools in their operations, allowing them to unleash Arts without relying on a staff. Though they won't attack while on Standby, they will cruelly expend their own life to complete their mission once in Combat-Ready mode.
abilities: Starts battle in Standby and will not attack; upon being injured, becomes Combat-Ready and attacks two targets with long-ranged Arts damage.

sarkaz_caster.name: Sarkaz Caster
sarkaz_caster.flavourText: A mercenary from Sarkaz. They use complex Arts to attack. Proceed with caution.
abilities: Uses chains to paralyze allied Operators.

armored_burdenbeast.name: Armored Burdenbeast
armored_burdenbeast.flavourText: Large, slow, and docile, these burdenbeasts obediently undergo rigorous training to perform tasks that go against their nature.
abilities: Will be tripped by a Stabilizer Chain, stunning itself and dealing Physical damage to nearby enemies.

bloated_beetleball.name: Bloated Beetleball
bloated_beetleball.flavourText: An Originium beetle plays the part of the football. It sucks in air to expand rapidly when it feels threatened, to scare away predators, but this just makes it all the more adorable to those present.
abilities: Becomes bigger when kicked, requiring more damage to move
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

floating_charged_ball.name: Floating Charged Ball
floating_charged_ball.flavourText: Football inspired by a flying machine in order to enrich the match experience. Its complex kinetic structure allows it to fly for extended periods when enough force is applied... What was its original purpose again?
abilities: Temporarily gains Flying when kicked.

fluffy_pink_balloon.name: Fluffy Pink Balloon
fluffy_pink_balloon.flavourText: A football that imitates a furry critter to enrich the match experience... Hey, where did it go? Okay, it's actually a real furry critter that's drifting through the air right now.
abilities: A very light football that can be easily moved.
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

leaking_beetleball.name: Leaking Beetleball
leaking_beetleball.flavourText: An Originium beetle plays the part of the football. It sucks in air to expand rapidly when it feels threatened, but this one seems to have a leak and keeps getting flatter as it rolls.
abilities: Becomes smaller when kicked, requiring less damage to move
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

rma70_spikeball.name: RMA70 Spikeball
rma70_spikeball.flavourText: A football that imitates RMA70 minerals to enrich the match experience. Its spikes are surprisingly benign. Players who have tried it say that kicking it is a highly interactive experience.
abilities: A standard football.
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

sarkaz_bladeweaver.name: Sarkaz Bladeweaver
sarkaz_bladeweaver.flavourText: A Sarkaz mercenary. The Originium flowing through their blood allows them to hold these crudely modified Arts-imbued greatswords. Though they won't attack while on Standby, they are capable of dealing melee attacks that inflict Arts damage while in Combat-Ready mode.
abilities: Starts battle in Standby and will not attack; upon being injured, becomes Combat-Ready and inflicts Arts damage with melee attacks.
